zh.title: 國際民航組織選出四國加入理事會 完成40席擴編
zh.summary: 衣索比亞、印尼、阿曼與土耳其於國際民航組織特別大會當選理事國。
body: 國際民航組織（ICAO）11月20日在蒙特婁舉行第43屆大會特別會議，選出衣索比亞、印尼、阿曼和土耳其加入理事會。四國當選後，擴編後的40席理事會組成完整。
這次增選源於《國際民用航空公約》第50條第（a）款的修正議定書。議定書於2026年6月12日生效，將理事會席次由36席增為40席。
國際民航組織表示，這次組成的理事會將任職至下次改選。下一次理事會選舉預定於2028年的第44屆大會舉行。

en.title: ICAO elects four countries to complete its expanded 40-seat Council
en.summary: Ethiopia, Indonesia, Oman and Türkiye won seats at an extraordinary session of the aviation body’s Assembly.
body: ICAO’s 43rd Assembly elected Ethiopia, Indonesia, Oman and Türkiye to the Council at an extraordinary session in Montreal on November 20. Their election filled the four new seats on the expanded body.

The additional seats follow an amendment to Article 50(a) of the Convention on International Civil Aviation. The amendment protocol entered into force on June 12, 2026, increasing Council membership from 36 to 40 states.
ICAO said the newly constituted Council will govern the organisation until the next Council elections. Those elections are scheduled for the 44th Assembly in 2028.

facts.claim: ICAO elected Ethiopia, Indonesia, Oman and Türkiye on November 20.
The amendment expanding the Council from 36 to 40 members entered into force on June 12.
The next elections are scheduled for the 44th Assembly in 2028.
